detailed_task_description: Open the Safari browser, navigate to YouTube, search for a specific song, and start playback of the top result. The workflow uses Spotlight to launch Safari, types the YouTube website into the address bar and selects the suggested site, then uses YouTube's search box to find the requested song. The search query is parameterized so different song names can be used without changing the steps. The final step opens the top matching video and begins playing it.

task_params.name: song_name
task_params.description: The search query used in YouTube's search box to find the song/video (used in the 'Search YouTube' subtask).

success_criteria: A YouTube video matching the provided song name loads in the browser and playback begins (audio starts playing).

subtasks.text: Activate the desktop and launch Safari using Spotlight. Expected outcome: Safari is launched and its window is frontmost.

steps.expected_current_state: macOS desktop showing the wallpaper with a small red dashed selection box near the center-left and a screen-sharing banner visible at the bottom; the menu bar shows 'Python' as the active app.
steps.intent: Dismiss the red dashed selection box and activate the desktop/Finder.

target.primary: Small red dashed selection box (square) on the desktop wallpaper near the center-left of the screen

post_action: The red dashed selection box is removed from the desktop.
The desktop becomes active (menu bar shows Finder).

steps.expected_current_state: macOS desktop is visible (Finder menu bar at top, desktop icons on the right) with no app window focused and Spotlight not currently open.
steps.intent: Open Spotlight search using the system keyboard shortcut.

target.primary: Magnifying glass (Spotlight) icon in the top-right menu bar near the system status icons

post_action: A Spotlight search field appears near the top center of the screen.
Keyboard focus moves to the Spotlight input so you can type a query.

steps.expected_current_state: macOS desktop with the Spotlight search overlay open near the top-center of the screen; the Spotlight text field is visible and focused (shows placeholder 'Spotlight Search').
steps.intent: Type safari into the Spotlight search box to locate the Safari app.

target.primary: Spotlight Search text field in the overlay near the top-center (shows placeholder 'Spotlight Search').

post_action: The Spotlight input shows the entered text and the results list updates.
Matching items (apps/suggestions) appear in the results below the search field.

steps.expected_current_state: macOS Spotlight search overlay is open with the query 'safari' entered and the top search result highlighted in the Spotlight results list.
steps.intent: Open the Safari application from Spotlight search.

target.primary: Spotlight search result row labeled 'Safari' with the Safari icon near the top of the Spotlight window
target.fallback: the first result in the Spotlight search results list

post_action: The Safari browser window opens showing the start page.
The address/search bar in Safari becomes available (focused).

subtasks.text: Navigate to the YouTube website from Safari's address bar suggestions. Expected outcome: The YouTube homepage (or search results page) loads in the browser.

steps.expected_current_state: Safari start/new tab page is open. The address/search bar at the top is focused and ready for text input.
steps.intent: Enter the website name into the address/search bar to bring up matching suggestions.

target.primary: Address/search bar at the top center of the Safari window (shows placeholder like 'Search or enter website name')

post_action: The address/search field now contains the entered text.
A dropdown of site/search suggestions appears or updates below the address bar.

steps.expected_current_state: Safari window is open with the address bar focused and an autocomplete suggestions dropdown visible near the top; a suggestion reading "YouTube — youtube.com" is shown in the list.
steps.intent: Open the suggested YouTube website from the address-bar suggestions.

target.primary: Autocomplete suggestion labeled "YouTube — youtube.com" in the address bar dropdown near the top of the browser
target.fallback: Top item in the address-bar suggestions popup (Siri Suggested Website entry) near the top center

post_action: The browser navigates to the selected website and the tab's content updates.
The page displays the site's homepage layout, including the site search bar and main navigation.

subtasks.text: Search YouTube for "{song_name}" and start playing the top result. Expected outcome: A video matching "{song_name}" loads and playback begins.

steps.expected_current_state: YouTube open in the browser showing the top header with a visible search field and a main prompt that says 'Try searching to get started'; the search input is visible but not focused.
steps.intent: Place focus into the YouTube search box so the user can enter a search query.

target.primary: Search input field (placeholder 'Search') in the top-center header, with a magnifying-glass icon to its right
target.fallback: magnifying-glass icon button to the right of the search field near the top center

post_action: The search input becomes focused and shows a text caret.
A highlighted/active outline appears around the search field.

steps.expected_current_state: YouTube open in a Safari window showing the homepage; the top-center search field is focused (caret visible) and the page displays a 'Try searching to get started' message.
steps.intent: Type a search query into YouTube's search box to find a song.

target.primary: Top-center search text box with visible placeholder text 'Search' and a magnifying-glass icon to its right (in the page header).
target.fallback: Magnifying-glass icon button to the right of the top-center search box in the header.

post_action: The search input is populated with the entered text.
A clear (X) control appears in the search area and the caret is positioned after the entry.

steps.expected_current_state: YouTube open in the browser on the search page with a query visible in the top search bar and the main content area currently prompting to search (no results shown).
steps.intent: Execute the search so the page loads video results for the query in the search bar.

target.primary: Magnifying-glass (search) button at the right end of the top search bar
target.fallback: Search input field in the top bar (press Enter)

post_action: The page updates to show search results.
Video thumbnails and titles appear in the main content area.

steps.expected_current_state: Web browser on YouTube showing search results for the query; a list of video results is visible with the top result's thumbnail and title shown near the top of the page. The top video is not yet opened in the watch player.
steps.intent: Open and start playing the top search result (the 'Numb' music video).

target.primary: The top result's video thumbnail or title text reading "Numb (Official Music Video) [4K UPGRADE] – Linkin Park" near the top of the results (left side of the result row).
target.fallback: The large thumbnail of the first video result at the top of the search results list (left side).

post_action: The video opens in the watch page and the video player with playback controls appears.
Related videos and the video description/metadata are displayed alongside the player.
